name: fix_terraform_security_group_open_ssh
description: aws_security_group allows SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0 -> restrict to a specific admin CIDR, proven by real terraform validate; incomplete-fix broken adds a new properly-scoped ingress rule but leaves the original wide-open rule in place, so port 22 is still reachable from the entire internet through it
prompts: The aws_security_group named app in main.tf has an ingress rule allowing SSH (port 22) from cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] - the entire internet, not just administrators. Fix this so port 22 is only reachable from a specific admin CIDR block: add a new string variable admin_cidr (default "10.0.0.0/16") and change the ingress rule's cidr_blocks to reference it instead of the wildcard. There must be NO ingress rule left anywhere in the security group that allows port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 - do not just add a second, more restricted rule alongside the original one. Run `terraform fmt`.

test_setup_files.check_security_group.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

fmt = subprocess.run(["terraform", "fmt", "-check", "-diff"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert fmt.returncode == 0, f"terraform fmt -check failed:\n{fmt.stdout}\n{fmt.stderr}"

init = subprocess.run(["terraform", "init", "-backend=false", "-input=false"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f"terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}"

validate = subprocess.run(["terraform", "validate", "-no-color", "-json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get("valid") is True, f"terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}"

content = open("main.tf", encoding="utf-8").read()

assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_security_group"\s+"app"\s*\{', content), "security group resource lost"

# the whole point: NO ingress rule may leave port 22 open to the entire
# internet, whether it's the only rule or one of several
assert '"0.0.0.0/0"' not in content, (
    "main.tf still contains a 0.0.0.0/0 CIDR block - port 22 is reachable from the entire "
    "internet, even if a more restricted rule was ALSO added alongside it")

assert re.search(r"from_port\s*=\s*22", content), "the SSH ingress rule (port 22) was removed entirely"

print("PASS terraform security-group CIDR checks")
